rationale: Wind damage to roof shingles on the policyholder's own residential structure is textbook property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Windstorm damage to four roof shingles on back porch overhang; no water intrusion. Estimated repair cost $400. Claim is below the $2,500 deductible and will not result in coverage payout.

case_facts.description: Four shingles blown off overhang above back porch by weekend wind
